title: Ọrụ Ebube nke Ihe Ngosi Na-adịghị Ekwu Okwu
intro: Ị ga-ahụ akụkọ gbasara onye Chineke nyere aka nke e zoro ezo. Akụkọ banyere ihe enyemaka ọrụ ebube na nchebe na-enweghị okwu nke na-ada ụda ka oge na-aga. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta onye chere ule a pụrụ iche ihu?
clues: Anatara m ozi Chineke nke mere ka m nwee ihe ijuanya
Ndị m jụrụ m ịdị ọcha m mgbe m lọtara na nwatakịrị
E nyere m iwu ka m buo ọnụ ka m ghara ikwu okwu ruo oge ụfọdụ
Isi iyi mmiri na mkpụrụ osisi date kwadoro m n'oge ikpe m
Onyenwe m mere ka osisi dị egwu maa jijiji iji nye m ihe niile m chọrọ
Mmụọ ozi pụtara ìhè n'ihu m n'ụdị mmadụ zuru oke

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịmụ nwa naanị gị n'okpuru osisi nkwụ
trial.answer: Ịmụ nwa naanị gị n'okpuru osisi nkwụ

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E gosipụtara na aka m dị ọcha mgbe nwa m nwoke kwuru okwu
Aghọrọ m eze nwanyị a na-asọpụrụ
E bibiri ndị m site n'ahụhụ Chineke
Eduru m mba m gaa mmeri
Olulu mmiri ọrụ ebube pụtara ìhè ruo mgbe ebighị ebi
outcome.answer: E gosipụtara na aka m dị ọcha mgbe nwa m nwoke kwuru okwu

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
